blocks.html: Insulating materials used in noncombustible construction must either: Satisfactorily pass a test for determining noncombustibility of elementary materials, based on the test procedures of ASTM E 136; or Have a flame spread index not greater than 25, a smoke-development index not greater than 50, and be without evidence of continued progressive combustion when tested in accordance with ASTM E 84.
